# Printed Benchy photograph

`printed-benchy.jpg` is the unmodified original photograph by **#3DBenchy**,
taken May 4, 2015 and distributed under
[CC BY 2.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/).

- [Source and reviewed licence](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:-3DBenchy_3D-printed_at_low_resolution_on_a_BEETHEFIRST_3D_printer_(17203395618).jpg)
- [Original author publication](https://flickr.com/photos/132390309@N03/17203395618)
- SHA-256: `84fd043236afb4d6c1e1327de9db0869e6c44b572d858d864d8ff5aac990a3ad`

The photograph shows a physical print of the existing
`testdata/benchy/3dbenchy.stl` fixture (SHA-256
`6ab57f1c3f8e86bc3cbd302c6fa6270acf06277c6335454e922419c25d42e97e`).
The source Model is identified by the photographer's publication; it is not
an assistant-generated image. The model's rights holder confirms its
[public-domain release](https://www.nti-group.com/home/news/3dbenchy/).

This is a single photo-to-Model retrieval case, separate from the frozen
32-query text-to-shape study. It does not establish broad photo recall or
independent human-query acceptance. No cropping, retouching or background
removal is used. Normal production image decoding supplies RGB to the encoder.
